notes:
- feat(downloads): show downloads in a dark panel under the toolbar's download button, with progress, time left, open, show in folder, cancel and clear all
- feat(downloads): open the panel for a few seconds when a download starts, without taking the keyboard from the page
- feat(downloads): show a progress ring on the toolbar's download icon while a download runs
- feat(downloads): ask before opening a downloaded program such as an .exe or .msi
- fix(downloads): cancel a download that is still running when the user signs out
- feat(passwords): add a close button to the save-password prompt; it and Esc dismiss the prompt without blocking the site
- fix(passwords): offer "Update password?" only when the password really changed
- fix(passwords): offer "Not now" instead of "Never" where "Never" would delete a saved password for that site
- fix(ui): stop the address bar's suggestion list from staying open over the page after clicking away or pressing Esc
- feat(ui): show the exit button on the toolbar on every seat; a policy exit password still guards it
- fix(session): stop the start page from staying blank after sign-in on slow PCs
- fix(policy): apply a keep-signed-in change at the next sign-in instead of in the middle of a session
